verses.original: מִ֥י הֶאֱמִ֖ין לִשְׁמֻעָתֵ֑נוּ וּזְר֥וֹעַ יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ מִ֥י נִגְלָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: mî he·’ĕ·mîn liš·mu·‘ā·ṯê·nū ū·zə·rō·w·a‘ Yah·weh ‘al- mî niḡ·lā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Who has believed our message And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed
verses.literalPt: QUEM deu crédito à nossa pregação? E a quem se manifestou o braço do SENHOR?

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַל כַּיּוֹנֵ֜ק לְפָנָ֗יו וְכַשֹּׁ֙רֶשׁ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֔ה לֹא־ תֹ֥אַר ל֖וֹ וְלֹ֣א הָדָ֑ר וְנִרְאֵ֥הוּ וְלֹֽא־ מַרְאֶ֖ה וְנֶחְמְדֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al kay·yō·w·nêq lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·ḵaš·šō·reš mê·’e·reṣ ṣî·yāh lō- ṯō·’ar lōw wə·lō hā·ḏār wə·nir·’ê·hū wə·lō- mar·’eh wə·neḥ·mə·ḏê·hū
verses.literal: He grew up before Him like a tender shoot and like a root out of dry ground He had no stately form or majesty to attract us no beauty that we should desire Him
verses.literalPt: Porque foi subindo como renovo perante ele, e como raiz de uma terra seca; não tinha beleza nem formosura e, olhando nós para ele, não havia boa aparência nele, para que o desejássemos.

verses.original: נִבְזֶה֙ וַחֲדַ֣ל אִישִׁ֔ים אִ֥ישׁ מַכְאֹב֖וֹת וִיד֣וּעַ חֹ֑לִי וּכְמַסְתֵּ֤ר פָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ נִבְזֶ֖ה וְלֹ֥א חֲשַׁבְנֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: niḇ·zeh wa·ḥă·ḏal ’î·šîm ’îš maḵ·’ō·ḇō·wṯ wî·ḏū·a‘ ḥō·lî ū·ḵə·mas·têr pā·nîm mim·men·nū niḇ·zeh wə·lō ḥă·šaḇ·nu·hū
verses.literal: He was despised and rejected by men a man of sorrows acquainted with grief Like one from whom men hide . . . their faces He was despised and we esteemed Him not
verses.literalPt: Era desprezado, e o mais rejeitado entre os homens, homem de dores, e experimentado nos trabalhos; e, como um de quem os homens escondiam o rosto, era desprezado, e não fizemos dele caso algum.

verses.original: אָכֵ֤ן חֳלָיֵ֙נוּ֙ ה֣וּא נָשָׂ֔א וּמַכְאֹבֵ֖ינוּ סְבָלָ֑ם וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ חֲשַׁבְנֻ֔הוּ נָג֛וּעַ מֻכֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים וּמְעֻנֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḵên ḥo·lā·yê·nū hū nā·śā ū·maḵ·’ō·ḇê·nū sə·ḇā·lām wa·’ă·naḥ·nū ḥă·šaḇ·nu·hū nā·ḡū·a‘ muk·kêh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·mə·‘un·neh
verses.literal: Surely He took up our infirmities and carried our sorrows yet we considered Him stricken struck down by God and afflicted
verses.literalPt: Verdadeiramente ele tomou sobre si as nossas enfermidades, e as nossas dores levou sobre si; e nós o reputávamos por aflito, ferido de Deus, e oprimido.

verses.original: וְהוּא֙ מְחֹלָ֣ל מִפְּשָׁעֵ֔נוּ מְדֻכָּ֖א מֵעֲוֺנֹתֵ֑ינוּ מוּסַ֤ר שְׁלוֹמֵ֙נוּ֙ עָלָ֔יו וּבַחֲבֻרָת֖וֹ נִרְפָּא־ לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū mə·ḥō·lāl mip·pə·šā·‘ê·nū mə·ḏuk·kā mê·‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·nū mū·sar šə·lō·w·mê·nū ‘ā·lāw ū·ḇa·ḥă·ḇu·rā·ṯōw nir·pā- lā·nū
verses.literal: But He was pierced for our transgressions He was crushed for our iniquities the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him and by His stripes we are healed
verses.literalPt: Mas ele foi ferido por causa das nossas transgressões, e moído por causa das nossas iniqüidades; o castigo que nos traz a paz estava sobre ele, e pelas suas pisaduras fomos sarados.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֙נוּ֙ כַּצֹּ֣אן תָּעִ֔ינוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְדַרְכּ֖וֹ פָּנִ֑ינוּ וַֽיהוָה֙ הִפְגִּ֣יעַ בּ֔וֹ אֵ֖ת עֲוֺ֥ן כֻּלָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lā·nū kaṣ·ṣōn tā·‘î·nū ’îš lə·ḏar·kōw pā·nî·nū Yah·weh hip̄·gî·a‘ bōw ’êṯ ‘ă·wōn kul·lā·nū
verses.literal: We all like sheep have gone astray each one has turned to his own way and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all
verses.literalPt: Todos nós andávamos desgarrados como ovelhas; cada um se desviava pelo seu caminho; mas o SENHOR fez cair sobre ele a iniqüidade de nós todos.

verses.original: נִגַּ֨שׂ וְה֣וּא נַעֲנֶה֮ וְלֹ֣א יִפְתַּח־ פִּיו֒ כַּשֶּׂה֙ לַטֶּ֣בַח יוּבָ֔ל וּכְרָחֵ֕ל לִפְנֵ֥י גֹזְזֶ֖יהָ נֶאֱלָ֑מָה וְלֹ֥א יִפְתַּ֖ח פִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: nig·gaś wə·hū na·‘ă·neh wə·lō yip̄·taḥ- pîw kaś·śeh laṭ·ṭe·ḇaḥ yū·ḇāl ū·ḵə·rā·ḥêl lip̄·nê ḡō·zə·ze·hā ne·’ĕ·lā·māh wə·lō yip̄·taḥ pîw
verses.literal: He was oppressed . . . and afflicted yet He did not open His mouth He was led like a lamb to the slaughter and as a sheep before her shearers is silent so He did not open His mouth
verses.literalPt: Ele foi oprimido e afligido, mas não abriu a sua boca; como um cordeiro foi levado ao matadouro, e como a ovelha muda perante os seus tosquiadores, assim ele não abriu a sua boca.

verses.original: מֵעֹ֤צֶר וּמִמִּשְׁפָּט֙ לֻקָּ֔ח וְאֶת־ דּוֹר֖וֹ מִ֣י יְשׂוֹחֵ֑חַ כִּ֤י נִגְזַר֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֔ים מִפֶּ֥שַׁע עַמִּ֖י נֶ֥גַע לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ō·ṣer ū·mim·miš·pāṭ luq·qāḥ wə·’eṯ- dō·w·rōw mî yə·śō·w·ḥê·aḥ kî niḡ·zar mê·’e·reṣ ḥay·yîm mip·pe·ša‘ ‘am·mî ne·ḡa‘ lā·mōw
verses.literal: By oppression and judgment He was taken away and who can recount His descendants For He was cut off from the land of the living He was stricken for the transgression of My people
verses.literalPt: Da opressão e do juízo foi tirado; e quem contará o tempo da sua vida? Porquanto foi cortado da terra dos viventes; pela transgressão do meu povo ele foi atingido.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־ רְשָׁעִים֙ קִבְר֔וֹ וְאֶת־ עָשִׁ֖יר בְּמֹתָ֑יו עַ֚ל לֹא־ חָמָ֣ס עָשָׂ֔ה וְלֹ֥א מִרְמָ֖ה בְּפִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ’eṯ- rə·šā·‘îm qiḇ·rōw wə·’eṯ- ‘ā·šîr bə·mō·ṯāw ‘al lō- ḥā·mās ‘ā·śāh wə·lō mir·māh bə·p̄îw
verses.literal: He was assigned a grave with the wicked and with a rich man in His death although He had done no violence nor was any deceit in His mouth
verses.literalPt: E puseram a sua sepultura com os ímpios, e com o rico na sua morte; ainda que nunca cometeu injustiça, nem houve engano na sua boca.

verses.original: וַיהוָ֞ה חָפֵ֤ץ דַּכְּאוֹ֙ הֶֽחֱלִ֔י אִם־ תָּשִׂ֤ים אָשָׁם֙ נַפְשׁ֔וֹ יִרְאֶ֥ה זֶ֖רַע יַאֲרִ֣יךְ יָמִ֑ים וְחֵ֥פֶץ יְהוָ֖ה בְּיָד֥וֹ יִצְלָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ḥā·p̄êṣ dak·kə·’ōw he·ḥĕ·lî ’im- tā·śîm ’ā·šām nap̄·šōw yir·’eh ze·ra‘ ya·’ă·rîḵ yā·mîm wə·ḥê·p̄eṣ Yah·weh bə·yā·ḏōw yiṣ·lāḥ
verses.literal: Yet it was the LORD’s will to crush Him and to cause Him to suffer and when His soul is made a guilt offering He will see His offspring He will prolong His days and the good pleasure of the LORD will prosper in His hand
verses.literalPt: Todavia, ao SENHOR agradou moê-lo, fazendo-o enfermar; quando a sua alma se puser por expiação do pecado, verá a sua posteridade, prolongará os seus dias; e o bom prazer do SENHOR prosperará na sua mão.

verses.original: מֵעֲמַ֤ל נַפְשׁוֹ֙ יִרְאֶ֣ה יִשְׂבָּ֔ע בְּדַעְתּ֗וֹ יַצְדִּ֥יק צַדִּ֛יק עַבְדִּ֖י לָֽרַבִּ֑ים וַעֲוֺנֹתָ֖ם ה֥וּא יִסְבֹּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ă·mal nap̄·šōw yir·’eh yiś·bā‘ bə·ḏa‘·tōw yaṣ·dîq ṣad·dîq ‘aḇ·dî lā·rab·bîm wa·‘ă·wō·nō·ṯām hū yis·bōl
verses.literal: After the anguish of His soul He will see the light of life and be satisfied By His knowledge My righteous Servant will justify many and He will bear their iniquities
verses.literalPt: Ele verá o fruto do trabalho da sua alma, e ficará satisfeito; com o seu conhecimento o meu servo, o justo, justificará a muitos; porque as iniqüidades deles levará sobre si.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֲחַלֶּק־ ל֣וֹ בָרַבִּ֗ים וְאֶת־ עֲצוּמִים֮ יְחַלֵּ֣ק שָׁלָל֒ תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱרָ֤ה לַמָּ֙וֶת֙ נַפְשׁ֔וֹ וְאֶת־ פֹּשְׁעִ֖ים נִמְנָ֑ה וְהוּא֙ חֵטְא־ רַבִּ֣ים נָשָׂ֔א וְלַפֹּשְׁעִ֖ים יַפְגִּֽיעַ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ă·ḥal·leq- lōw ḇā·rab·bîm wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·ṣū·mîm yə·ḥal·lêq šā·lāl ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·rāh lam·mā·weṯ nap̄·šōw wə·’eṯ- pō·šə·‘îm nim·nāh wə·hū ḥêṭ- rab·bîm nā·śā wə·lap·pō·šə·‘îm yap̄·gî·a‘
verses.literal: Therefore I will allot Him a portion . . . with the great and He will divide the spoils with the strong because He has poured out His life unto death and He was numbered with the transgressors Yet He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors
verses.literalPt: Por isso lhe darei a parte de muitos, e com os poderosos repartirá ele o despojo; porquanto derramou a sua alma na morte, e foi contado com os transgressores; mas ele levou sobre si o pecado de muitos, e intercedeu pelos transgressores.
